code:
SELECT TOP 10 wait_type, wait_time_ms,
       signal_wait_time_ms,
       wait_time_ms - signal_wait_time_ms
         AS resource_wait_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type NOT IN ('SLEEP_TASK',
  'LAZYWRITER_SLEEP','WAITFOR')
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;
caption: Cumulative since restart — filter benign waits before ranking.
